web.title: Custom web applications
web.lead: Software built to fit exactly how you work, not the other way around.
bullets: Internal tools that replace spreadsheets and manual processes
Dashboards, back-office systems, and platforms built around your operation
Clean, fast architecture ready to grow
web.problem: Right now you're running on spreadsheets, copy-pasting between tools, and repeating the same tasks every week. It works... until it doesn't. I build an application shaped exactly to your process, one that handles that repetitive work for you.
web.howIWork: I start by understanding your real problem, not a feature list. I build in phases and show you progress early, so we adjust based on something you can actually use, not a document. I stay close throughout the whole process.
includes: Internal tools that replace manual processes

sevilla.title: Freelance Web Developer in Seville
sevilla.lede: I'm Adri Chavero. I build custom software for small businesses across Seville and all of Andalusia: web applications, online stores, and integrations that solve a specific problem, not generic templates.

whatIDo.heading: Custom web development, from idea to product
whatIDo.p1: Web application development in Seville is usually sold off the shelf: a template, a few tweaks, and off you go. I work the other way around. First I understand your business and the problem eating up your time, then I design and build the software that solves it.
whatIDo.p2: I build custom web applications, management dashboards, integrations between your systems (ERP, e-commerce, invoicing), and online store development in Seville when what you need is to sell. One person from start to finish: you talk directly to me, no handoffs, no surprises.

forWhom.heading: Built for businesses in Seville and Andalusia
forWhom.p1: I mostly work with small businesses, freelancers, and companies in Seville and the surrounding area that already have a manual process or a tool they've outgrown. If you're running your operation on spreadsheets, WhatsApp, and copy-paste, that's where custom web development makes the difference.
list: Web applications and management dashboards for your daily operations
Online store development in Seville, connected to your systems
Integrations between ERP, e-commerce, and invoicing
Maintenance and ongoing development of what you already have running
forWhom.p2: I don't focus on a single industry: what my projects have in common is that they all start from a real business problem. I've worked with industrial companies, opticians, agencies, and startups, and in every case the starting point was the same: an operation running on spreadsheets, emails, and manual processes that had reached their limit.

howIWork.heading: You talk directly to me, start to finish
howIWork.p1: I don't subcontract or pass you from one person to another. The web development you're hiring is done by me: the same person who understands your business is the one writing the code and the one who picks up the phone when something breaks.
howIWork.p2: I work in phases and show you progress early, on something you can actually use, not a hundred-page document. That way we adjust fast and you don't get surprises at the end. Once we launch, I stay close to maintain it and grow it with you. I'm based in Seville, so we can also meet in person if you prefer, though most of the work runs smoothly remote.

about.heading: From a small town in Extremadura to your project.
about.portraitAlt: Monesterio, the town in Extremadura where Adri Chavero grew up
about.paragraph1: I'm from Monesterio, a small town in southern Extremadura, from a working-class family where nobody looks down on anyone. I wasn't one of those kids coding at twelve: I got into this because my father told me it had a future, and I found the passion for it later, in college.
about.paragraph2: What came after taught me mostly what kind of work I didn't want. At every company I worked for, there was a wall between me and the people who actually used what I built: other people, a process, always something in the way. I worked half-blind, never really knowing if what I made helped anyone. And it turns out that's exactly what drives me: knowing I made someone's day easier.
about.paragraph3: That's why I went freelance: to tear that wall down. Today I work as a freelance software engineer based in Spain, and to me this isn't about delivering a project and disappearing, it's about caring about your product as if it were mine. Working with me, you talk directly and clearly with the person building your software, and I see firsthand whether it's actually changing things for you. No handoffs, no surprises.
